description:
Analysis extent for Flood, Rwanda, 4 May 2023 (FL20230504RWA): 20 features merged from 20 source layers. Layers whose names mark the area UNOSAT analysed, or parts of it with no usable imagery (analysis extent, area of interest, cloud obstruction, no-data, image footprint). The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Damage assessment along the Mukungwa river, Western & Northern Provinces, Rwanda as of 10 May 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-along-the-mukungwa-river-western-northern-provinces-rwanda-as-of-10-may-)
- [Damage assessment along the Sebaya River, Rubavu and Karongi Districts, Western Province, Rwanda. - 6 May 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-along-the-sebaya-river-rubavu-and-karongi-districts-western-province-rwa)
- [Preliminary satellite flood and landslide assessment report, Along Sebaya River, Rubavu District, Karongi Districtn Western Province, Rwanda](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/preliminary-satellite-flood-and-landslide-assessment-report-along-sebaya-river-rubavu-dist)
- [Satellite detected landslides / mudslides over Kibingo, Congonil, Kagana and Ghanga Villages, Rutsiro District, Western Province, Rwanda  as of 7 May 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/landslides-mudslides-over-kibingo-congonil-kagana-and-ghanga-villages-rutsiro-district-wes)
- [Satellite detected water extent along the Nyabarongo river West and South of Kigali City in Southern and Eastern Provinces, Rwanda as of 5 May 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/water-extent-along-the-nyabarongo-river-west-and-south-of-kigali-city-in-southern-and-east)
- [Satellite detected water extent over Kigali City, Southern, Northern, Western, and Eastern Provinces, Rwanda  as of 3 May 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/water-extent-over-kigali-city-southern-northern-western-and-eastern-provinces-rwanda-as-of)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: SensorDate
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: SensorID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The 3 source files of this collection use 3 different domains for it, so read `SensorID_label`, which is decoded per source file.

table:columns.name: Area_m2
table:columns.description: Area in square metres, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: GlobalID
table:columns.description: ArcGIS global identifier of the feature.

table:columns.name: StaffID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The 3 source files of this collection use 3 different domains for it, so read `StaffID_label`, which is decoded per source file.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Length
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Area
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: Area_ha
table:columns.description: Area in hectares, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: SensorID_label
table:columns.description: `SensorID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: StaffID_label
table:columns.description: `StaffID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: Site_ID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = UN Building; 1 = Mosque; 2 = Hospital; 3 = Refugee / IDP Camp Building; 4 = Market; 5 = School / University; 6 = Square; 7 = Government Building; 9 = Border Crossing Point; 12 = Cemetary; 13 = Ruins; 16 = Stadium; 19 = Sewage Treatment Facility; 21 = Greenhouse; 22 = Bridge; 23 = Road; 24 = Tower; 25 = Prison; 26 = Building (General / Default); 27 = Field; 28 = Industrial Facility; 30 = Refugee / IDP Camp Site; 35 = Transport Vehicle; 40 = Military Base; 41 = Checkpoint; 42 = Military Facility; 45 = Suspected Mass Grave Site; 46 = Airport Facility; 47 = Church. The decoded text is in `Site_ID_label`.

table:columns.name: Site_ID_label
table:columns.description: `Site_ID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Leng
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
